title: FROM
definition: The instruction that initializes a new build stage and sets the Base Image for subsequent instructions. It is the mandatory first instruction in a valid Dockerfile.
simpleExplanation: Choosing your starting canvas. You can't build something out of nothing. You must tell Docker what operating system to start with.
realWorldExample: `FROM ubuntu:22.04` starts with a pure Linux environment. `FROM python:3.9` starts with Linux but saves you time by already having Python pre-installed.

basic: Can you have a Dockerfile without a `FROM` statement?

answers.question: No FROM?
answers.answer: No. Every single Dockerfile must begin with a `FROM` statement.
